Its low oxidation susceptibility should suit the 4.0 V operating window.

proposal.motivation: LiNbF6 (mp-aaacjjwh) gave penalty_bin 1 (0.029 eV/non-Li atom, acceptable), and Li2TiF6 (mp-aaaaalgl) gave bin 3, so fluorides with d0 high-valence cations are the most promising family. Li2SiF6 is the remaining untested fluoride with a d0 central cation.
